scripts.prepare: node -e "import('node:child_process').then(({execSync})=>{try{execSync('git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree',{stdio:'ignore'});execSync('git config core.hooksPath .githooks')}catch{}})" && node tools.mjs install && rustup toolchain install 1.85.0 --profile minimal
scripts.check: concurrently --group "cargo fmt --check" "cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings" "cargo run --locked -- check" "cargo +1.85.0 check --locked --all-targets --target-dir target/msrv"
